criteria.requirement: Fix actual lint.Filter Doctype checks to validate publicId and systemId themselves as None or text, independently of optional name. Invalid numeric/bytes/container identifiers with a valid name must raise AssertionError; valid text identifiers with name=None must pass. Preserve token identity, lazy iteration and all existing non-Doctype validation, and verify a real parsed DOM walker stream. Do not coerce bad identifiers to text or disable lint assertions.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
